verdict.rationale: Auth0 explicitly documents the Client Credentials flow as the recommended mechanism for M2M applications (CLIs, daemons, backend services) authenticating via Client ID/Secret to obtain an access token without user involvement, and this is reinforced by a dedicated machine-to-machine feature page and broader agent-auth docs (unique agent identities, Token Vault, CIBA) showing this extends into AI-agent scenarios. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation specifically of the M2M flow for AI agents (community evidence is general sentiment, not concrete testing of this flow).
